novel_features.name: Cost-aware thread completion
novel_features.description: Fetch one post's complete comment threads, automatically picking the cheaper route between the 15-credit flat include_replies call and 1-credit per-comment reply calls (don't trust child_comment_count to decide: it's unreliable).
novel_features.rationale: Routes on thread economics the API doesn't expose, and reports the routing decision and credits charged in the envelope.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when you need every reply on a post without doing credit arithmetic by hand.

novel_features.name: Reply-gap audit
novel_features.description: Rank synced posts by how many comments the API reported versus how many actually landed in your local store — ground truth where the API's child_comment_count is unreliable as a thread filter.
novel_features.rationale: Ground truth from a local join where the API's child_comment_count is measurably unreliable (1 false negative per 5 real threads).
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this after a sweep to find which posts are silently missing their replies.

novel_features.name: Pre-flight credit estimator
novel_features.description: Project the credit cost of a planned run against your live balance and exit non-zero if it would exhaust the budget.
novel_features.rationale: Combines the per-endpoint credit table with the live credits_remaining field into a go/no-go gate.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Run this before any bulk sweep so an agent never burns the balance mid-pipeline.

novel_features.name: Cross-platform presence matrix
novel_features.description: Given one handle, see which of 12 creator platforms the creator is on with follower counts side-by-side.
novel_features.rationale: No single API call answers where a creator lives; this fans out and collates.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Start any collab qualification here before pulling per-platform detail.

novel_features.name: Transcript full-text search
novel_features.description: FTS5 full-text search across every platform transcript you've synced — nine resource types spanning YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, Rumble, and more.
novel_features.rationale: Paid transcripts become a re-queryable offline corpus instead of one-shot responses.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Search transcripts you already paid for instead of re-fetching them.

novel_features.name: Brand ad campaign monitor
novel_features.description: Snapshot a brand's live ads across Facebook, TikTok, Google, and LinkedIn ad libraries; on rerun, diff new ads versus ones that disappeared.
novel_features.rationale: Ad-library endpoints are memoryless; the local snapshot store turns dumps into diffs.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Rerun weekly and read only the delta of a competitor's ad activity.

novel_features.name: Bulk comment sweep
novel_features.description: Pull recent posts for a handle and their comments in one command, stopping cleanly at a credit budget you set.
novel_features.rationale: Posts-to-comments fan-out with a credit circuit breaker no endpoint offers.
novel_features.why_it_matters: The one-command version of a multi-hundred-post comment-mining ritual, budget-gated.

novel_features.name: Comment corpus FTS
novel_features.description: Full-text search across every synced comment and reply, offline.
novel_features.rationale: No API search over comments exists at all; FTS5 over the local corpus fills the gap.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Mine questions and complaints from comments you already pulled without spending credits.

novel_features.name: Credit burn projection
novel_features.description: See how fast you're spending API credits and how many days remain at the current pace.
novel_features.rationale: Computed from the API's credit balance and daily usage history.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Check runway before committing to a new recurring pipeline.

novel_features.name: Multi-creator comparison
novel_features.description: Compare two or more creators side-by-side on follower count, engagement rate, and content volume.
novel_features.rationale: Local-store computation across profiles the API only returns one at a time.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Strip vanity follower counts out of a collab decision.

novel_features.name: Engagement spike detector
novel_features.description: Surface the videos that performed far above a creator's own baseline — the ones that actually went viral.
novel_features.rationale: Needs the whole local history to compute a per-creator baseline.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Find outlier content without eyeballing hundreds of posts.

novel_features.name: Trend triangulation
novel_features.description: Snapshot a hashtag or topic across platforms in one call to see which platform it is biggest on.
novel_features.rationale: Cross-platform fan-out no single endpoint provides.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Decide where to publish before creating the content.

novel_features.name: Follower growth tracker
novel_features.description: Append a follower snapshot per run on a chosen platform, then read the growth trajectory over time.
novel_features.rationale: Time-series the API never returns; built from your own snapshots.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Track a partner's growth on a schedule you control.

novel_features.name: UGC tag watcher
novel_features.description: Snapshot the posts a creator or brand is tagged in and diff new mentions on rerun.
novel_features.rationale: Adds snapshot-diff memory to the memoryless tagged-posts endpoint.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Weekly UGC check for a client brand without re-reading the full list.

narrative.headline: Every Scrape Creators endpoint across 28 platforms, with credit-aware comment mining and a local corpus no other Scrape Creators tool has.
narrative.value_prop: The official CLI mirrors endpoints and the official skills describe curl workflows; neither remembers anything between runs. This CLI syncs profiles, posts, comments with their replies, transcripts, and ads into SQLite with FTS5 search, routes comment-thread fetches on credit economics (comments thread), audits reply completeness against ground truth (comments coverage), and gates expensive sweeps behind a pre-flight credit estimate (account estimate).

quickstart.comment: Verify the binary, config, and API reachability before spending a credit
One handle in, presence and follower counts across 12 platforms out
Complete comment threads for one post, routed on the cheaper of the two reply endpoints
Project what a sweep will cost before running it
Mine the synced comment corpus offline, no credits spent

troubleshoots.fix: Your API key is missing or invalid: run scrape-creators-pp-cli auth set-token <key>, or export SCRAPECREATORS_API_KEY

troubleshoots.symptom: A comments command returns success with no comments key
troubleshoots.fix: Update the binary — pre-2026.8 builds stripped the payload under --agent; current builds never strip the sole payload array
It hit --max-credits; raise the budget or rerun after checking scrape-creators-pp-cli account budget

troubleshoots.symptom: comments coverage flags posts you believe are complete
troubleshoots.fix: The API's reported counts include replies; run comments thread on the flagged post to close the gap, then re-audit

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI when a task touches public social-media data at scale: mining comments and replies for a brand, qualifying creators across platforms, monitoring competitor ads, or searching transcript/comment corpora you have already synced. It is the right choice whenever credit economics matter — its thread routing, sweep budgets, and pre-flight estimates exist so agents never spend blind.
anti_triggers: Do not use this CLI to post, like, follow, or message on any platform — it is read-only public-data scraping
Do not use it for private/logged-in-only content; it sees what the public sees
Do not use it as a general web scraper for non-social sites; use a crawling tool instead

recipes.explanation: Fetches every top-level comment and reply with cost-aware routing, then narrows the envelope to just the text fields an agent needs.

recipes.explanation: Pulls the week's posts and their comments, stopping cleanly when the credit budget is hit.

recipes.title: Find the gaps before spending
recipes.explanation: Ranks synced posts by missing-thread gap so reply credits go only where threads are incomplete.

recipes.title: Offline comment mining
recipes.explanation: FTS5 search over the synced corpus — zero credits.

recipes.title: Collab qualification in two calls
recipes.command: scrape-creators-pp-cli creator find <handle> --agent && scrape-creators-pp-cli creator compare <handle> <rival> --agent
recipes.explanation: Presence matrix first, then engagement comparison to strip vanity followers.
